provenance.instrument: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (AI Act), as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 (Digital Omnibus on AI)
provenance.note: Corpus files are the consolidated Article text with EUR-Lex consolidation markers (▼B, ▼M1), markdown link syntax, non-breaking spaces and soft hyphens removed. See src/lib/rulepack/normalise.ts — the citation verifier applies the same normalisation to both sides before matching.

changelog: Adds Annex III (the high-risk use-case list) to the corpus. No Article text changed: the nineteen article-*.txt files are byte-identical carry-overs from 2026-08-10, and their hashes in this manifest are the same values — that identity is the evidence, not a claim. corpusCutOff is unchanged at 2026-07-27 and the CELEX is the same consolidation (02024R1689-20260727); annex-iii.txt was fetched from it on 2026-08-18 via scripts/rulepack-fetch-annex.ts, which refuses to write unless the served document's own consolidation date matches this manifest. WHY: Compliance Checker v2 requires an exact Article 6 / Annex route behind every high-risk result (spec §20.2), and an Annex III citation could not be verified against a corpus that carried only Articles — verifyCitation() returned 'uncovered', which the verifier must treat as unverifiable rather than as a pass. Carried forward from 2026-08-10: Digital Omnibus on AI (Regulation (EU) 2026/1744, OJ 24.7.2026, in force 27.7.2026) — Annex III high-risk from 2 Dec 2027; Annex I from 2 Aug 2028; new Art 5(1)(ba) and (bb) prohibitions from 2 Dec 2026; SMC category (Arts 11, 17, 57, 99(6a)); Art 50 transparency in force 2 Aug 2026; penalty tiers at EUR 15M/3% for Art 50 and GPAI (Arts 99(4)(g), 101); the Art 6(3) profiling override; retention at Arts 19(1)/26(6) with Art 12 as the logging capability only; Art 57(1) sandbox deadline 2 Aug 2027.
